reviewer_type: Post-hoc selective AI source review, not human ground truth
scope: Inspected exact-quote check results for all 12 rental memories; semantically reviewed only the eight records whose stored exact_user_source_quote check is false. This is not a complete memory recall, semantic accuracy, summary accuracy, qualification, status or supersession audit.
selection: Parent identified eight invalid exact-quote occurrences; the stored flags and direct source-string membership independently reproduce exactly those eight. Selection is post hoc and targeted, not a new random or blinded sample.

source_policy.allowed_sources: Canonical role=user history; prior T1 text additionally allowed only for T2-stage generation. Assistant history, previous model answers, gold and future T2 text are not used to support these judgments.
source_policy.temporal_warning: T2 in a memory call name denotes preparation for the T2 response, not permission to use the user’s future T2 corrections. Earlier absence values here are assessed at memory-generation time.

execution_scope: Offline source inspection and deterministic validation only. No benchmark model CLI/API or external-model calls; current AI review is outside benchmark CLI token totals. No raw, frozen or blinded-review records were edited and no commit was made.

summary.interpretation: Eight invalid occurrences are four original fact-record defects plus four unchanged dependency-linked copies. Two separate initial S3 calls contain the same relationship-ellipsis pattern, so there are three distinct textual/source patterns but four originating records. These counts are not eight independent generation errors and are not a complete semantic error rate.

source_boundary.note: T1-stage memory is assessed against canonical user history only; T2-stage memory against that history plus prior T1. The future T2 update is excluded.
